entries.10bd7be220198a66: Centered on the manufacture and sale of household and industrial paints, it handles DIY products such as interior and house-care products and gardening products, and pet food and pet products, and from the fiscal year ended March 2026 has also started selling watch accessories.
entries.1dc69c4964d8bf5d: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥16,822 million. By business, the paint business was ¥7,318 million, the DIY business ¥4,821 million, the pet products business ¥3,376 million, and the watch accessories business ¥1,054 million. Revenue rose due to the conversion of the watch accessories business into a subsidiary, but this was offset by a decline in revenue from the pet products business, which had performed well in the previous year, and by weak consumer spending.
